Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of delivery notes.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to delivery notes.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer. This name will appear in dropdown menus when selecting a footer for delivery notes.

Content

Enter the content that will appear at the bottom of delivery notes. You can include delivery terms, contact information, or any other relevant details.

Inactive

Mark this footer as inactive to prevent it from appearing in footer selection dropdowns. Existing delivery notes using this footer will not be affected.
